aboutPage.meta.description: HatchGrab builds practical software for food trucks and mobile serving: online orders, collection times and fewer repetitive questions. Founded by Dominic Bonini.
aboutPage.meta.title: About us — HatchGrab
aboutPage.story.build: We build practical software specifically for food trucks and mobile serving, helping them take online orders, manage collection times, keep orders flowing smoothly and spend less time dealing with repetitive questions.
aboutPage.story.change: HatchGrab was created to change that.
aboutPage.story.fixedAddress: Yet much of the software available to them is designed around businesses with a fixed address.
aboutPage.story.focus: Our focus is simple: make running a food truck easier, with tools designed around how these businesses actually operate.
aboutPage.story.start: HatchGrab started with a simple observation: food trucks need better tools to run their businesses.
aboutPage.story.villageFoodie: After creating Village Foodie, an overview helping people discover food trucks visiting their local area, I spent more time learning about the challenges mobile food businesses face. Unlike traditional restaurants, food trucks are constantly moving, working at different locations and serving customers in changing conditions.

featuresPage.detail.advance_preordering: Let customers pre-order for a later date or a later time before the event.
featuresPage.detail.advanced_reporting: Break down sales by period, dish and event to see what really sells.

featuresPage.detail.discovery_map_listin: Your food truck appears on the public HatchGrab map, so nearby customers find you.

featuresPage.detail.event_types: Create your own event types, with your own prices and settings for events and festivals.
featuresPage.detail.kitchen_app: The most complete way to use HatchGrab: a real-time kitchen screen, and the only way to keep taking orders when you lose coverage.
featuresPage.detail.kitchen_capacity: Set how much the kitchen can cook at a time and how long it takes. When a time slot is full, customers can’t choose it.

featuresPage.detail.meal_deals_upsells: Combine dishes into meal deals and offer extras at checkout to raise the average order.
featuresPage.detail.messenger_instagram_: The same as automatic replies on WhatsApp, for enquiries on Messenger and Instagram.
featuresPage.detail.multi_device_kitchen: Use several screens — at the counter window and in the kitchen — all showing the same orders in real time.
featuresPage.detail.multi_user_access: Give staff their own logins with the right access level.
featuresPage.detail.offline_protection: If you lose coverage, online ordering pauses so customers can’t place orders you don’t see. With the app for iPhone, iPad and Android you can keep taking orders without internet; the web dashboard needs a connection.

featuresPage.detail.preorder_deadline: Set an order deadline for dishes that must be ordered in good time.
featuresPage.detail.private_events: Add private events that don’t show on the map, with their own private order link and QR code.
featuresPage.detail.qr_code: A QR code for printing that opens your menu and order page.
featuresPage.detail.schedule_import: We fill in your schedule automatically — from your website or a picture you already post on Facebook. You just look it over and confirm.
featuresPage.detail.sms_order_alerts: Send customers an SMS automatically when the order is ready.
featuresPage.detail.social_media_posts: Upload your designs — we automatically add dates, places and times for each week and each event.
featuresPage.detail.sold_out_toggle: Mark a dish as sold out with one tap — it is greyed out for customers straight away.
featuresPage.detail.stock_countdown: Set a stock number and it counts down as orders come in, and the dish sells out automatically.
featuresPage.detail.tap_to_pay: Take card payments on a supported phone, so you don’t need a separate card terminal.
featuresPage.detail.ticket_printing: Print order tickets on a Bluetooth or wired printer in the kitchen.
featuresPage.detail.time_slot_selection: Customers choose a collection time in a time slot, so demand is spread across the service.
featuresPage.detail.walkup_orders: Take and handle orders at the counter window, paid on your own card terminal.
featuresPage.detail.web_dashboard: Run the service from the browser on any phone, tablet or laptop.

landing.does.capacityBody: Set how much you can cook at once, and how long it takes. When a collection time is full, customers can’t choose it.
landing.does.devicesBody: Runs on the phone in your apron, the tablet on the counter, the laptop in the food truck — and the card terminal you already take payment with.
landing.does.lede: Most ordering systems assume a fixed address, stable wifi and the same opening hours every week. You’re somewhere new every week, at different times, with poor or no mobile coverage. HatchGrab is made for exactly that.
landing.does.offlineBody: If you lose coverage, online ordering pauses automatically so customers can’t place orders you don’t see. Keep taking orders with the app for iPhone, iPad and Android.
landing.does.postsBody: Upload the design you already use on Facebook or Instagram. We fill in dates, places and times, ready to share — every week or every day.
landing.does.postsTitle: Automate your posts on Facebook and Instagram
landing.does.slotsBody: Customers pre-order, choose a collection time and skip the queue. The food is ready when they arrive.
landing.does.title: Made for food trucks, not restaurants.
landing.does.whatsappBody: «Where are you tonight?» «Which desserts do you have?» Your WhatsApp messages get answered while you drive to the pitch or stand at the grill, based on your own menu and schedule. Messenger and Instagram coming soon.
landing.does.whatsappSoonBody: «Where are you tonight?» «Which desserts do you have?» Soon your WhatsApp messages will get answered while you drive to the pitch or stand at the grill. Messenger and Instagram will follow.
landing.final.lede: Upload a picture or a screenshot of your menu, and we turn it into a working ordering page you can try out in under 60 seconds. Your dishes, your prices. No signup, no card, nothing to install. Have a look, and decide afterwards.
